title: ampacus daniellii
intro: Ampacus daniellii, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). The plant is known for its vibrant yellow or orange flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ampacus daniellii include its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation, attributed to the bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
